name: government-public
appliesTo: Public services, e-government portals, utilities, licensing, tax, public transport, universities' administrative side. Terminology is frequently fixed by the document it comes from.

address.citizen: công dân in official text; ông/bà on forms; anh/chị in guidance and help screens.
address.self: Cơ quan / đơn vị / the office's own name. Not `bên mình`.

properNouns: Cổng Dịch vụ công Quốc gia

glossary.why: CCCD replaced CMND. Using the old term on a live form sends people to the wrong queue.
The word every procedure document uses.

extraRules.why: Administrative abbreviations are transparent to the office and opaque to the citizen. On a first-use screen they stop the task.
extraRules.instead: spell it out on first use, abbreviate afterwards — `bảo hiểm xã hội (BHXH)`
extraRules.falsePositives: Later uses in the same flow are fine. Allow those strings explicitly.

notes: Officialese is permitted here because the source documents are official — but only where it mirrors a real legal phrase. Guidance and error messages should still be plain: the citizen has to complete a task, and a passive construction on an error screen is where people give up. Where a statute prescribes wording, quote it and do not improve it.
